noVNC 1.7.0 — HTML5 VNC client library
Upstream: https://github.com/novnc/noVNC (npm package @novnc/novnc@1.7.0,
obtained with `npm pack @novnc/novnc@1.7.0`).

Vendored unchanged: core/, vendor/pako/, AUTHORS, LICENSE.txt, docs/LICENSE.*
(the app/ UI of noVNC is not included; HostingOS uses the RFB library from
static/js/console.js as an ES module).

Licence: noVNC is MPL-2.0 (see LICENSE.txt and docs/LICENSE.MPL-2.0);
